def free_add_disposal_repairs(raw, uid, statements):
    text = low(raw)
    if 'if requested' in text and 'return any and all materials' in text:
        material = ['acquired_material_v3', 'all_source_stated_materials', raw]
        action = ['return_to', material, ['disclosing_party']]
        add_statement(statements, ['disposal_obligation', ['receiving_party'], action, ['request_by', ['disclosing_party']], ['no_exceptions']], [uid])
    agreement_end = has_any(text, ['expiration or termination ofthis agreement', 'expiration or termination of this agreement'])
    request = has_any(text, ['request of auditee', 'request by auditee', 'upon request'])
    if agreement_end and request and 'return' in text and 'destroy' in text and 'confidential information' in text:
        material = ['information_bundle', ['confidential_information'], ['information_bundle', ['copies_of', ['confidential_information']], ['derivative_materials_of', ['confidential_information']]]]
        action = ['action_alternative', ['return_to', material, ['disclosing_party']], ['destroy', material]]
        trigger = ['trigger_alternative', ['agreement_termination'], ['request_by', ['disclosing_party']]]
        add_statement(statements, ['disposal_obligation', ['receiving_party'], action, trigger, ['no_exceptions']], [uid])
    authorized_destroy = has_any(text, ['where expressly authorised in writing', 'where expressly authorized in writing'])
    demanded_return = has_any(text, ['upon demand', 'upon request']) and 'return' in text
    if authorized_destroy and demanded_return and 'confidential information' in text and has_any(text, ['destroy', 'delete']):
        material = ['information_bundle', ['confidential_information'], ['copies_of', ['confidential_information']]]
        returned = ['return_to', material, ['disclosing_party']]
        destroyed = ['destroy', material]
        action = ['authorized_action_alternative', returned, destroyed, raw]
        trigger = ['request_by', ['disclosing_party']]
        add_statement(statements, ['disposal_obligation', ['receiving_party'], action, trigger, ['no_exceptions']], [uid])
value.rationale: 当前批次的可修复残差集中在 4607 来源，而不是已正确处理的 a5b0 或 bbb3。第一，现有 Free 源读取器把“employees of companies directly or indirectly owned or controlled by the Recipient”同时读成 Recipient 自有员工和受控实体员工，违反已提供的角色范围审查；修改后仅在条款另有明确 Recipient 自有员工措辞时保留自有员工，并继续保留受控实体员工、顾问、条件和逐字证据。第二，同一来源的处置条款规定按要求返还全部保密信息及副本，销毁仅在书面授权时作为替代；现有组合没有形成可执行 Norm。新增纯组合修复使用库中已有的 authorized_action_alternative，保留请求触发、完整材料范围和销毁授权限定，不把它弱化成无条件 OR，也不虚构留存禁止。未知、完整来源缺失判断以及其他来源能力保持不变。
